lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 1 fix 001: address reviewer finding

nextStoryContext: ADR-0050's 'Eliminated candidates and runners-up' section (AC5) was rewritten per the reviewer's US-R1-001 finding: nine of the eleven eliminated-candidate bullets (keelgate, deckrun, shipset, gatework, bowmark, keelward, wayhelm, gatepath, gaterun) had fabricated aesthetic rejection reasons instead of the measured layer-1/layer-4 evidence from CAM-434 spec.acceptanceCriteria[4]; only the helm- prefix family entry was already correct and was left unchanged. Also corrected the prowmark runner-up entry, which had mislabeled the Promark collision as 'a live layer-4-adjacent confusion risk': Promark is a D'Addario percussion brand (1957), a distant category, not an adjacent one, so the entry now says so explicitly while still recording the elimination. The deckward runner-up entry (line 64) was NOT touched by this story: the reviewer's finding for that entry is a separate story (US-R1-002, the Valve Steam Frame codename mis-attribution), not part of this one. No code, template, or binary was touched (docs-only ADR correction).
